gloss.en: The root نَقَرَ (naqara) primarily means to peck, like a bird, or to strike with a pointed object. It extends to striking a musical instrument, making a sound to urge an animal, or boring/perforating.
gloss.short: The root نَقَرَ (naqara) primarily means to peck, like a bird, or to strike with a pointed object.
